today_in_history_posts.title: Full Disclosure: CVE-2023-40231 / CVE-2023-40232 / CVE-2023-40233 / CVE-2023-40234 "All your mempool are belong to us"
today_in_history_posts.summary: - The author discusses lightning vulnerabilities, emphasizing careful disclosure to avoid increasing exploitation risks.  - Multiple specific security threats are detailed, including replacement cycling and network congestions exploited by attackers.  - The author urges improved base-layer solutions and plans to further address these issues publicly over time.

today_in_history_posts.title: Segwit Ephemeral Anchors
today_in_history_posts.summary: - Ephemeral Anchors enable key-less outputs with immediate spending, but legacy scripts bring malleability issues.  - Using wsh(OP_TRUE) is inefficient due to extra output bytes and a redundant witness script.  - An alternative leverages bip141 softfork, reducing overhead and requiring relay rule relaxation for spending.
